scope: Phase-two final batch: registered web/print outputs and document replacement failures. SDK unchanged.
status: Phase two complete. Final Release build, complete functional run, native module/web UI runs, paired timing and following same-program control passed. Earlier unstable captures remain retained. Later-stage checks remain explicit.
implemented: OutputCommands owns web and print work, input IDs, retained parameters, print contents and final output records. Built-in dialogs read public query values and reply through the same commands as external modules.

Web composition/HTML, optional NMS/DSC and regression print images share OutputFiles staging, verification-before-publication and reverse restoration. Single-file exports retain their original atomic replacement path without redundant backups.

Print captures independent Script models, display options and cloned bitmaps. No print work retains a SchematicCanvas or Document pointer. Native print adapters keep their existing tile/margin/submission behavior. PNG page drivers remain isolated from production.

New and Open prepare independent candidates. Native validation precedes view detachment; execution ends only inside the admitted commit. Failed detach or later admission preserves the old document, selection, undo/redo, save state and playback. View attachment failures retain a committed new document and report diagnostics.

Pending document interactions are refused consistently. Failed layout capture completes its file operation without native writes. Runtime log queries read a copied projection while native work owns the execution engine, with incremental appends and correct clear/trim behavior.

Once a nested provider accepts asynchronous work, the application preserves native completion and actual output paths even if an outer provider throws. Callback diagnostics remain attached to the eventual result.

checks.build: macos-arm64 Release production, native/core tests, standalone modules and UI executable built successfully.

failures: Production printing image driver was not isolated. Restored test-only compilation; production marker checks unchanged.

The added native-load injector incorrectly invoked Dev edit commands. Replaced it with writes to native layout/picture chunks and asserted their restoration together with object references and undo/redo.
Single-output exports unnecessarily attempted backup creation. Kept atomic replacement for a single file, preserving existing failure paths and diagnostics.

retained_failures.reason: Corrected the one-shot save injector and made private backup candidates writable while copying read-only sources; original file permissions remain in the backup.

regressions: Independent C/C++ public header consumers without STL/SDK/SDL types passed.
Built-in web/print forms and standalone-module command/dialog replacement passed.
Web composition/player flags, retained title/path, dimensions, overwrite handling, invalid runtime metadata and original-file preservation passed.
Partial web publication rolls back the composition and does not open preview; late errors and closed views retain actual output paths.
Printer preparation, selection cancellation/failure, begin/page/tile/end/submit errors, submission IDs and cleanup passed through a real command owner and failing destination.
Actual GPU print images have four verified opaque pages; actual captured Script models and cloned bitmap pixels remain usable after source document/view destruction.

Document replacement before/after detach, failed restoration, repeated admission, dispatch failure, candidate failure, post-commit completion plus attachment failure, and live GPU-view recovery preserve the correct old/new document.
Save-before-open/Save-As layout capture exceptions finish without file writes or pending work; failed Save Version preserves the previous file, path, selection and history.
Native load failures restore native layout/picture chunks, document metadata, original object references and undo/redo together.
Runtime log append/trim/clear and busy queries passed. Generated NMO direct-open, existing file-byte round trips, export failure paths and SDK object behavior differential passed.

diagnosis.observed: Both old and new programs slowed in nearby groups. Read-only inspection found an unrelated process near one CPU core, WindowServer around 42% CPU and another renderer around 37%. No thermal/performance warning was recorded.
diagnosis.interpretation: Changing host load is a plausible contributor, not a proven single cause. Same-program control passed; that alone does not accept the unstable old/new comparisons.
unchanged: Release scene, source, binaries and measurement harness
diagnosis.next: After an idle interval, the paired comparison passed (+0.926460%, MAD 0.772728%/0.475474%). The immediately following same-program control also passed (+1.511027%, MAD 1.815119%/0.901400%). Source, binaries, harness, protocol and thresholds remained unchanged. This accepts the recorded scene; it does not establish uniform host stability.

remaining: Native physical-printer submission and Windows/Linux platform execution are not exercised here.
Failure of file restoration itself and races with an external writer remain recorded in later-stage checks. Failed restoration reports residual outputs and leaves backups.
Complex view/tool migration and their remaining native access continue in the later planned phases.
Permanently stuck native code still needs the separately planned process isolation.
